title: MALM / STORKLINTA bedroom furniture
description: MALM / STORKLINTA bedroom furniture, set of 2, oak veneer/oak effect, Queen MALM and STORKLINTA go well together since as they share the same clean and simple design. Combine MALM bed frame with STORKLINTA bedside table to create a modern look at home – easy to love and live with!
features: SKORVA midbeam is included in the price but packaged separately. It is required for the stability of the bed frame and to keep the mattress in place.
LURÖY slatted bed base is included in the price, but is packaged separately.
Mattress and bedlinens are sold separately.
materialAndCare: Head/footboard: Particleboard, Fiberboard, Honeycomb structure paper filling (min. 70% recycled), Oak veneer, Stain, Clear acrylic lacquer, Printed and embossed acrylic paint, Plastic edging; Bedside: Particleboard, Fiberboard, Oak veneer, Stain, Clear acrylic lacquer, Printed and embossed acrylic paint, Paper, Plastic edging; Bed slats: Layer-glued wood veneer, Adhesive resin as coating; Ribbon: 100 %polyester; Galvanized steel; Top panel/ Drawer front: Particleboard, Paper foil, Plastic edging; Side panel: Particleboard, Paper foil; Plinth: Fiberboard, Paper foil, Plastic edging; Back panel: Fiberboard; Bottom panel: Particleboard, Plastic edging; Drawer side/ Drawer back: Particleboard, Plastic foil; Drawer bottom: Fiberboard, Printed acrylic paint
